Name: Stardew Valley - Robin's love.
Author: strangedboy
Description:
Robin Casavel makes Robin a romanceable and marriageable NPC.

WHAT IT DOES
- You can give Robin a bouquet and date her once you reach the required friendship.
- You can marry her with the Mermaid's Pendant like any other marriage candidate.
- Adds a spouse room in your farmhouse and a spouse patio spot on your farm.
- Adds marriage dialogue and bouquet/pendant acceptance lines for Robin.

NOTE: the new dialogue is written in Portuguese.

EXPERIMENTAL RELEASE
This is an early version and it has not been tested in depth. Please report any bugs you find.

KNOWN ISSUES / LIMITATIONS
- Robin is still Demetrius's wife and Maru and Sebastian's mother in the base game. Other characters' dialogue is not changed.
- The Carpenter's Shop may be affected when Robin moves in with you. I have not checked how this behaves.
- The spouse room reuses an existing room layout from the base game as a placeholder.
- No marriage schedule is included, so Robin stays at home or on the patio.

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods. The folder RobinCasavel must contain manifest.json directly inside it.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
4. Reach 8 hearts with Robin and give her a bouquet.

Please back up your saves before trying any mod.

UNINSTALL
Delete the RobinCasavel folder from your Mods folder.

BUG REPORTS
Please post your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log) together with a description of the problem.

CREDITS
Made with Content Patcher by Pathoschild. No third-party art or assets are used.Robin Casavel makes Robin a romanceable and marriageable NPC.

EXPERIMENTAL RELEASE
This is an early version and it has not been tested in depth. Please back up your saves and report any bugs you find.

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI (https://smapi.io)
- Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

INSTALLATION (WINDOWS + STEAM)
1. Install SMAPI: download it from smapi.io, unzip it, and run "install on Windows.bat". Choose option 1 (your Stardew Valley folder) when asked, and follow the instructions on screen. For Linux or Mac, see smapi.io/install.
2. In Steam, right-click Stardew Valley > Properties > General > Launch Options, and paste this line (keep the straight quotes):

"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\StardewModdingAPI.exe" %command%

If your game is installed somewhere else, change the path to match. Without the quotes, Windows cuts the path at "Program Files" and shows an error.
3. Download Content Patcher and unzip its folder (ContentPatcher) into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Unzip this mod and put the RobinCasavel folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. The file manifest.json must be directly inside RobinCasavel (not inside a second RobinCasavel folder).
5. Click Play on Steam. A black SMAPI window opens next to the game.

Not using Steam? Run StardewModdingAPI.exe from your game folder instead.

HOW TO TELL IT IS WORKING
- In the black SMAPI window, "Content Patcher" and "Robin Casavel" appear in the list of loaded mods, with no red text.
- Robin accepts the Bouquet instead of refusing it.

HOW TO USE
1. Raise your friendship with Robin like with any other villager: talk to her daily, give gifts and watch her events.
2. At 8 hearts, give Robin a Bouquet. If the mod is working, she accepts it with a new line of dialogue. You are now dating.
3. Reach 10 hearts with her. You also need to have upgraded your farmhouse once and repaired the beach bridge.
4. Get a Mermaid's Pendant (see the Stardew Valley Wiki for how) and give it to Robin to propose.
5. After the wedding, Robin moves into your farmhouse. Her spouse room and patio spot are added by this mod.

KNOWN ISSUES / LIMITATIONS
- Robin is still Demetrius's wife and Maru and Sebastian's mother in the base game. Other characters' dialogue is not changed.
- The Carpenter's Shop may be affected when Robin moves in with you. I have not checked how this behaves.
- The spouse room reuses an existing room layout from the base game as a placeholder.
- No marriage schedule is included, so Robin stays at home or on the patio.

IF IT DOES NOT WORK
- Check that the RobinCasavel folder has manifest.json directly inside it.
- Check that ContentPatcher is installed in the Mods folder.
- Check that you started the game through SMAPI (the black window must open).
- Post your SMAPI log at smapi.io/log with a description of the problem.

UNINSTALL
Delete the RobinCasavel folder from your Mods folder.

CREDITS
Made with Content Patcher by Pathoschild. No third-party art or assets are used.
